# Substack MCP

> FastMCP 3.1+ server and React webapp dashboard for Substack feeds, drafting, stats, and community.

- Repository: https://github.com/sandraschi/substack-mcp
- Backend Port: 11163 (FastAPI + FastMCP HTTP `/mcp`)
- Webapp Port: 11164 (Vite React SPA)

## Tools Overview

- `substack_feed`: Ingest RSS feeds, list tracked publications, query cached articles.
- `substack_drafts`: Create, edit, list, delete, and convert Markdown drafts into Substack HTML.
- `substack_stats`: Record snapshot metrics, retrieve analytics history.
- `substack_community`: Fetch comments and post discussion replies.

## Usage

Connect via FastMCP HTTP transport at `http://127.0.0.1:11163/mcp`.
